messages:
Alice: Heads up — onboarding optoral-13b-v2. Weight files uploaded to s3://redwood-models/optoral/13b/v2/weights.tar.gz. Can infra point serving config to that path?
Mike: Got it. Are these sharded? I see weights-00, weights-01.. in bucket.
Alice: Yes, 8 shards. Also tokenizer has a weird extra BOS token in hf tokenizer.json, leads to off-by-one in kv cache. Repro: decoding adds <s> twice.
Jordan: Did you run convert-tokenizer.sh? We had to drop bos_special_token in v1.
Alice: Trying to reproduce — posted minimal snippet:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.decode([50256]))
```
It prints '<s>text' instead of 'text'.
Mike: Ok leave a comment in model-metadata.yaml (tokenizer: drop_bos: true).
Alice: FYI serving config I propose:
```
continuous_batching:
  max_batch_size: 64
  max_latency_ms: 12
  batch_timeout_ms: 6
  enable_prefix_merging: true
cache:
  kv_ttl_ms: 60000
  enabled: true
  policy: prefix
scheduler:
  fairness: weighted
  max_inflight: 128
max_total_tokens: 4096
```
Jordan: batch_timeout_ms 6 is aggressive for 13B on a8x. Maybe 10ms — otherwise we'll see dropped SLOs at p95.
Mike: Also need max_inflight per-GPU; set to 64 per-device then autoscale. If one device hits >80% util we should shed or fallback.
Alice: OK will update to batch_timeout_ms: 10 and max_inflight: 64.
Sara: CI flag failed earlier on config schema — missing 'policy' allowed? schema only has 'cache.enabled' + 'cache.ttl_ms', not 'policy'.
Alice: Right switched to cache.enabled: true and cache.policy: prefix (schema PR incoming).
Alice: Pushing MR now: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime-configs/-/merge_requests/312
Mike: quick review incoming.
CI-bot: config-lint failed — missing shard: weights-07 not found at s3://redwood-models/optoral/13b/v2/weights-07.
Infra-bot: reupload started for weights-07 (resume multipart). ETA ~30s.
Mike: thanks, that explains lint. Also note we need a weights.manifest with sha256 checksums.
Infra-bot: reupload complete at 1803006860. Manifest updated.
Alice: Re-running lint locally — passes now. Ran a smoke run against a single GPU with max_batch_size 32 and batch_timeout_ms 10, kv cache warm: p50~18ms, p95~48ms.
Jordan: LGTM, minor nit on comment formatting in model-metadata.yaml (inline comments should be full sentences).
Mike: Approved, merging once CI green.
CI-bot: pipeline passed — deploy queued to staging.
Alice: Deploy scheduled to staging for tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Will monitor latency + error rates for first hour.
Sara: Ping me if rv>5% or errors spike, I'll escalate to on-call.
Alice: Will do :thumbsup:
